cells.A: Native GDELT schema + explicit knowledge-base extensions. English identifiers for implementation; Ukrainian-facing explanation in delivery.

cells.B: Source-oriented ontology for global media monitoring; reusable alongside space and microelectronics KBs.
CAMEO = event actions and actor codes; GKG = document themes/entities; GCAM = document content-analysis measures.
KB technology/application tags and service vocabulary are local, not official GDELT classifications. Cross-map to industry workbooks.
Event = machine-extracted event record; Mention = event occurrence within a source document; GKG record = metadata for one processed document.
Events.GlobalEventID → Mentions.GlobalEventID; MentionIdentifier + MentionType ↔ GKG DocumentIdentifier + SourceCollectionIdentifier; may be one-to-many.
Keep event day, ingestion/update time, publication time if independently available, and retrieval time separately.
Store raw source IDs/URLs and extraction confidence independently of claim verification, source credibility and corroboration.
Public metadata, not complete media coverage or a primary factual registry. Avoid causal inference from co-occurrence. Respect publisher licensing.
GDELT Event 2.0; GKG format 2.1; GKG lookup snapshot November 2021; API docs from later releases. Reviewed 2026-11-19.
Full CAMEO/actor lookup and GCAM master text could not be retrieved in this review. Links retained; root codes and documented examples included, not full dictionaries.
Use source IDs, append-only raw ingestion, versioned vocabularies and evidence-backed promotion from claim to validated fact. No ingestion or live API benchmark performed.
